text: dsh-tidewatch 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的峰谷费用挂件。宿主端注册 costUsage 会话投影，按模型调用事件的时间和用量计算 DeepSeek 会话费用；浏览器端展示当前峰谷档位、切换倒计时、费用与账户余额，并提供立绘挂件和输入框胶囊两种布局。用户可查看分模型 Token 与费用、切换币种和编辑气泡内容。适合希望在对话界面查看 DeepSeek 费用与时段信息的用户。插件通过 DSH 宿主账户服务读取余额，不要求插件自有 API Key；运行需 DSH Web profile。

dsh-tidewatch adds DeepSeek pricing and session costs to DSH Web. It shows peak/off-peak status, countdown, balance and per-model usage in a floating or inline widget. Users can switch currency and edit bubble text. Balance comes from DSH's account service; no plugin API key is needed.

dsh-tidewatch 的功能「会话费用统计」：宿主投影读取模型调用的 token 用量，按调用时间对应的价格档累计当前会话成本，并显示总量及分模型明细。
dsh-tidewatch 的功能「峰谷状态与倒计时」：界面显示 DeepSeek 当前峰谷档位及到下一阶段的计时，价格规则按时间窗口和价格时代计算。
dsh-tidewatch 的功能「费用与余额面板」：展开界面可查看账户余额、会话 Token 和费用，并按模型查看花费明细；余额通过 DSH 宿主账户服务获取。
dsh-tidewatch 的功能「可切换界面布局」：客户端提供悬浮挂件和输入框胶囊两种呈现方式，用户可在界面中切换并查看会话信息。
dsh-tidewatch 的功能「自定义气泡内容」：面板内可增加或删除气泡页和行、编辑文案、调整顺序，并将常用行收藏到模块库。
dsh-tidewatch 使用浏览器 localStorage 保存气泡页、模块库等界面偏好；账户余额由 DSH 宿主账户服务读取，客户端代码未见插件自行请求余额 API。

dsh-tidewatch README · dsh-tidewatch：> DeepSeek Harness 的峰谷时刻挂件。一枚停在界面右下角的潮汐立绘，随时告诉你此刻是峰期还是谷期、距下一次切换还有多久、本次会话花了多少钱。

dsh-tidewatch README · 这是什么：DeepSeek 自 2026-08-17 起对 API 实行峰谷分时定价：峰期价目是谷期的两倍，周末与中国法定节假日全天按谷价。这意味着同样一次调用，落在不同钟点，账单可能差一倍。

`dsh-tidewatch` 把这件事摊开在你眼前：现在是什么档位、距离切换还有多久、这一场对话已经花了多少钱。金额按**每次调用实际发生的时刻**计价，回看历史会话也不会被当前价目重算。

它卖的是「口径可核对」：峰谷窗口、周末、法定节假日、调休、三段历史价格全部写在代码里，并配一条全年逐小时的口径比对脚本作为复核手段。

dsh-tidewatch README · 两种形态，随时切换：同一个版本内置两种界面形态，峰谷判定、会话费用、Token 明细、账户余额完全一致，差别只在长在哪里、长什么样。装一份就都有，**在面板里一键切换，立刻生效**，不用重装、不用刷新。

| 形态 | 长什么样 | 适合谁 |
|---|---|---|
| **立绘挂件** | 屏幕右下角一只立绘，可以拖到任意位置、松手吸附到左右边缘。点一下弹出漫画气泡，**再点一下翻页**看本次会话开销。峰期与谷期用不同立绘 | 喜欢有角色的、想看立绘随时段变化的 |
| **胶囊徽章** | 嵌在官方输入框下方那行统计里，与官方条目并排，**不占屏幕空间、不遮挡任何东西**；点一下直接展开完整面板 | 喜欢极简的、不想被浮层挡住的 |

dsh-tidewatch README · 切换形态：打开面板（点立绘出气泡 →「详情 ›」；胶囊形态直接点徽章）→ 面板底部「形态」一行，选「立绘挂件」或「胶囊徽章」。切换即时生效，偏好会被记住。

> 两种形态同时挂载、只渲染被选中的那一个；没被选中的不跑余额轮询与计时器，也不会在界面上留下占位。
dsh-tidewatch README · 手机与窄屏：详情面板会跟着视口收边：桌面宽屏上面板锚在徽章上方展开；手机竖屏（视口 ≤560px）时改按屏幕贴边展开——左右各留 8px、底边抬到统计行上方，内容多时在面板内部滚动。所以手机浏览器、或 DSH 的远程（remote）模式里点开胶囊，详情页都完整落在屏幕内，不会被边缘切掉。

dsh-tidewatch README · 特性：| 分类 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| **峰谷** | 官方峰谷窗口判定；秒级倒计时到下一阶段；周末与法定节假日全天谷期；调休上班的周末同样全天谷期 |
| **计费** | 三段历史价格时代（基础价 / 首版峰谷价 / V4.1 Flash 新价）按调用时刻选档；缓存命中与未命中分开计价；输出含推理 token |
| **余额** | 读取 DeepSeek 账户余额（充值 / 礼金 / 合计）与读数时刻 |
| **挂件** | 右下角常驻立绘，可拖拽，松手吸附到较近的一侧，位置持久化；峰期与谷期换不同立绘 |
| **形态** | 立绘挂件与胶囊徽章装在同一个版本里，面板里一键切换、即时生效，偏好会被记住 |
| **会话隔离** | 每个会话各记各的账：新建会话从 ¥0.00 起算，切回旧会话恢复它自己的数字，多会话并发也不串账 |
| **气泡** | 点立绘弹出漫画式对话气泡（大圆角 + 指向头顶的尖角）；**点气泡翻页**。收起只有两条路：约 5 秒后自己淡出，或点插件之外的任何地方 |
| **交互** | 点立绘出气泡、点气泡翻页；完整面板从气泡的「详情 ›」进入；面板右上角 `✕`、再点立绘、或点外部都会收起 |
| **编辑器** | 面板内置气泡编辑器：增删页与行、改模板文案、**拖拽排序**（也可点 ↑↓）、**模块库**（☆ 收藏常用行，一键插入）、一键恢复默认 |
| **泡泡玩法** | 一行内用 `A \|\| B` 并列随机、写成 `img:https://…` 渲染成图片（在线图与 data URI 均可） |
| **观感** | 跟随 GUI 亮暗主题（`--dsw-*` 变量）；复用 DSH 官方 UI 原语；合成提示音（无音频素材） |
| **账号通道** | 实测账号内置通道**自带 usage**，按 token 精准计价；只有这条通道确实拿不到用量时，才退回**余额差值**估算，金额标「（估算）」 |
| **诊断** | 用量异常时（一条结算事件都没收到，或有事件但一条不带用量）气泡底部出现一行排障信息；正常会话里不显示 |
| **不适用时** | 当前模型不是 DeepSeek 时显示「不适用」，不拿 Flash 价硬凑数字；同一会话里早先已计价的调用仍照常计入总额 |

dsh-tidewatch README · 使用：- **点立绘** → 面板开着时先收起面板，否则弹出气泡（再点不会收起，只会重置计时）；**点气泡** → 翻到下一页；约 5 秒后自己淡出，**点插件外任意位置**也会收起
- **气泡里的「详情 ›」** → 完整面板
- **点气泡里的「详情 ›」** → 展开完整面板：账户余额、本次会话 Token 与费用、当前档位价格、峰谷时段表（北京时间）、形态与币种切换、气泡编辑器、音效开关
- **拖动挂件** → 移到任意位置；松手靠近左右边缘会自动吸附，位置记在 `localStorage`
- **点「本次会话费用」行** → 展开分模型花费明细（各模型 token 与花费，合计等于各项之和）
- **收起面板** → 点面板右上角 `✕`、点挂件本身、或点面板外部

币种选择即时生效并记住；人民币 2 位小数，美元 4 位小数。

dsh-tidewatch README · 峰谷时段（官方依据）：DeepSeek 官方自 2026-08-17 起实施峰谷分时定价：

| 时段（UTC） | 北京时间 | 档位 |
|---|---|---|
| 01:00 – 04:00 | 09:00 – 12:00 | 峰 |
| 04:00 – 06:00 | 12:00 – 14:00 | 谷 |
| 06:00 – 10:00 | 14:00 – 18:00 | 峰 |
| 10:00 – 次日 01:00 | 18:00 – 次日 09:00 | 谷 |

谷期价格为峰期的一半。本插件按 UTC 窗口判定当前档位（官方英文页即按 UTC 小时书写），周几与法定节假日按北京自然日判定（官方中文页把周期锚在「北京时间周一至周五」上）。两种读法在当前窗口取值下等价：窗口均落在同一北京自然日内，且不成对跨越 UTC 日界。时段表展示一律按北京时间。

dsh-tidewatch README · 三段价格时代：价格按**调用发生时刻**选档，历史会话回看不会被当前价目重算。档位顺序为 缓存命中 / 输入未命中 / 输出（美元 / 1M tokens）：

| 时代 | 时间范围（UTC） | deepseek-flash 档位 |
|---|---|---|
| 基础价 | 2026-08-16 16:00 之前 | 0.0028 / 0.14 / 0.28 |
| 首版峰谷价 | 2026-08-16 16:00 ~ 2026-09-10 04:00 | 峰 0.014 / 0.44 / 1.32，谷为峰的一半 |
| V4.1 Flash 新价 | 2026-09-10 04:00 起 | 峰 0.006 / 0.3 / 1.2，谷为峰的一半 |

成本 = 输入未命中 × cacheMiss + 输出 × output + (缓存读 + 缓存写) × cacheHit；「输出」已含推理 token。账本以美元存储。

dsh-tidewatch README · 三段价格时代：人民币数字另存一份官方**中文**定价页的原样数字用于展示，不做汇率换算：官网两个模型的隐含汇率并不相同（flash 约 6.67、pro 约 6.82），统一换算会让 pro 的元数字比官网低约 2%。**会话总额同样按每个模型各自的官方汇率折算**（有分模型账时逐模型换算，没有时退回统一汇率），所以 flash 与 pro 混用的会话也不会被拉偏。

dsh-tidewatch README · 周末与法定节假日：- **周六 / 周日**全天按谷期计价（官方公告：「周六、周日全天不再区分峰谷时段，统一按低谷时段价格收取调用费用」）
- **中国法定节假日**全天按谷期计价，无峰谷切换，也没有生效时间（官方定价页脚注：「高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）……包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段」）
- **调休上班的周末**同样全天谷期（官方说明：「调休上班的周末、中国法定节假日全天均按空闲时段计费」）
- 下一阶段的切换点 = 下一个工作日首次进入峰时

节假日表依据《国务院办公厅关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2025〕7 号，共 33 天）：元旦 1/1–1/3、春节 2/15–2/23、清明 4/4–4/6、劳动节 5/1–5/5、端午 6/19–6/21、中秋 9/25–9/27、国庆 10/1–10/7。

dsh-tidewatch README · 兼容性：| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 0.1.7-rc.2 及以上；已适配 0.2.0 |

dsh-tidewatch README · 已知限制：- **价格表内置**，官方调价后需手动同步 `lib/pricing.js`（计费）与 `lib/client.js` 的 `DISPLAY_PRICES`（展示）两处常量，并为旧价补一段历史档
- **节假日表内置 2026 年**，2027 年安排公布后需手动同步 `CN_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS`（同样两处）；过期后周一到周五一律按工作日计，法定节假日会被按峰期收费，面板会提示表已过期
- **V4 Pro 换价分界**目前是哨兵值：官方声明计费方式保持不变，如有变动需把日期填回 `V4_PRO_RETIRE_BOUNDARY`
- **失败或被重试的调用不计费**，与官方 token-meter 口径一致；这是口径上限
- **账号内置通道的两种口径**：本机实测该通道（provider `deepseek-account`）的结算事件**自带 usage**，按 token 精确计价；若某次确实拿不到 usage，才退回「账户余额下降了多少」估算，金额后标注「（估算）」。余额属于账户级，多会话或多设备同时使用会一起下降，估算因此偏大；只累加下降、充值不抵消消耗
- **官方投影采样的两处取舍**：宿主侧用 `sessionProjections.snapshot(session, ['tokenUsage'])` 读取 DSH 官方的 `tokenUsage` 投影（对话页底部「351M tok · 缓存命中 97%」那行的来源），随视图下发供前端计价。官方投影只给累计总数，故这条路径按**当前**价目折算，无法精确到每次调用的历史档位；采样也只保留最近一次，多会话并发时以前台活跃的那个为准。这份采样只在「本会话收到过结算事件」时才随视图下发，空会话不会继承上一场的数字
- **用量缺失时如实标注**：拿不到任何用量又估算不出时，界面显示「未提供」而不是 `¥0.00`，避免把「没有数据」呈现成「免费」。用量的读取口径与 DSH 官方 `token-meter` 一致：同时读 `assistant/message` 与 `assistant/attempt`，按 `(turn, step)` 替换，重试清槽；若结算事件里字段名对不上（`totalTokens` 有值而各分桶全空），同样按「未提供」处理，不会静默记成零
- **不提供余额预警**：早期版本有一个「余额低于阈值响一声」的功能，阈值写死且不可配置，属于半成品；DeepSeek 控制台本身可能已有余额提醒，故移除，不做重复建设

dsh-tidewatch README · dsh-tidewatch：> A peak/off-peak tide widget for DeepSeek Harness. A little mascot parked in the bottom-right corner that tells you, at a glance, whether it's peak or off-peak right now, how long until the next switch, and how much this session has cost.

[](https://github.com/KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch/releases)
[](LICENSE)

dsh-tidewatch README · What this is：Since 2026-08-17 DeepSeek bills its API on a peak/off-peak schedule: peak prices are double the off-peak ones, and weekends plus Chinese public holidays are billed off-peak all day. The same call can cost twice as much depending on the clock.

dsh-tidewatch README · What this is：`dsh-tidewatch` puts that in front of you: which tier is active, how long until it flips, and what this conversation has cost so far. Every figure is priced at **the moment each call actually happened**, so revisiting an old session never reprices it at today's rates.

What it sells is a checkable definition: the peak windows, weekends, public holidays, make-up working days and all three historical price eras live in the code, backed by a full-year hour-by-hour comparison script.

dsh-tidewatch README · Two layouts, switch anytime：One build ships both interface layouts. Peak-window logic, session cost, token breakdown and account balance are identical — only the placement and appearance differ. Install once and switch **from the panel, effective immediately**, with no reinstall and no refresh.

dsh-tidewatch README · Two layouts, switch anytime：| Layout | What it looks like | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Mascot widget** | A mascot in the bottom-right corner, draggable anywhere and snapping to either edge. One click pops a comic bubble; **a second click turns the page** to this session's cost. Different artwork for peak and off-peak | If you like having a character around and want the artwork to follow the tide |
| **Inline capsule** | Sits in the official composer row beside the built-in stats — **no screen space taken, nothing covered**; one click opens the full panel | If you want it minimal and out of the way |

dsh-tidewatch README · Switching layouts：Open the panel (click the mascot, then `详情 ›`; the capsule opens it directly) → the **Layout** row at the bottom → pick **Mascot widget** or **Inline capsule**. The switch is immediate and the choice is remembered.

> Both layouts stay mounted and only the selected one renders; the other runs no balance polling or timers and leaves no gap in the UI.

dsh-tidewatch README · Mobile and narrow screens：The detail panel stays inside the viewport. On a wide desktop window it anchors above the badge; on a phone held upright (viewport ≤560px) it switches to screen-edge docking — 8px on each side, lifted above the stats row, scrolling inside the panel when the content is tall. So opening the capsule in a phone browser, or through DSH's remote mode, keeps the whole panel on screen instead of clipping its left edge.

dsh-tidewatch README · Features：| Area | Capability |
|---|---|
| **Peak windows** | Official window rules; second-by-second countdown to the next phase; weekends and Chinese public holidays billed off-peak all day; make-up working weekends likewise |
| **Billing** | Three historical price eras (base / first peak schedule / V4.1 Flash repricing) chosen by each call's timestamp; cache hit and miss priced separately; output includes reasoning tokens |
| **Balance** | DeepSeek account balance (paid / bonus / total) with the reading time |
| **Widget** | Mascot pinned to the bottom-right corner, draggable, snaps to the nearer edge on release, position persisted; a different pose for peak and off-peak |
| **Layouts** | Mascot widget and inline capsule ship in one build; switch from the panel, effective immediately, and the choice is remembered |
| **Session isolation** | Each session keeps its own tally: a new session starts at zero, switching back restores that session's own figures, and concurrent sessions never bleed into each other |
| **Bubble** | Clicking the mascot pops a comic-style speech bubble (large radius, tail pointing at the head); **a click on the bubble turns the page**

dsh-tidewatch README · Usage：- **Click the mascot** → closes the panel when it is open, otherwise shows the bubble (clicking again never hides it, it only resets the timer); **clicking the bubble** turns to the next page; it fades out after about five seconds, and **a click outside the widget** dismisses it too
- **Click `详情 ›` inside the bubble** → the full panel
- **Click `详情 ›` in the bubble** → the full panel: account balance, this session's tokens and cost, current tier prices, official peak window table (Beijing time), layout and currency switches, bubble editor, sound switch
- **Drag the mascot** → move it anywhere; releasing near either edge snaps it there, and the position persists in `localStorage`
- **Click the session cost row** → per-model cost breakdown (tokens and cost per model; the total equals their sum)
- **Close the panel** → the `✕` at its top right, the mascot itself, or anywhere outside
dsh-tidewatch README · Usage：The currency choice takes effect immediately and is remembered; CNY shows 2 decimals, USD shows 4.

dsh-tidewatch README · Peak windows (official basis)：DeepSeek introduced peak/off-peak pricing on 2026-08-17:

| Window (UTC) | Beijing time | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| 01:00 – 04:00 | 09:00 – 12:00 | peak |
| 04:00 – 06:00 | 12:00 – 14:00 | off-peak |
| 06:00 – 10:00 | 14:00 – 18:00 | peak |
| 10:00 – next 01:00 | 18:00 – next 09:00 | off-peak |

dsh-tidewatch README · Peak windows (official basis)：Off-peak prices are half the peak ones. The plugin judges the active tier by UTC windows (the official English page writes them in UTC hours) and judges weekdays and holidays by Beijing calendar days (the official Chinese page anchors the schedule to Beijing Monday–Friday). Both readings agree under the current windows: each window falls inside one Beijing calendar day and no pair straddles the UTC date line. The window table is always displayed in Beijing time.

dsh-tidewatch README · Three price eras：Prices are chosen by **the moment a call happened**, so old sessions are never repriced. Tiers read cache hit / input miss / output, in USD per 1M tokens:

| Era | Range (UTC) | deepseek-flash tiers |
|---|---|---|
| Base | before 2026-08-16 16:00 | 0.0028 / 0.14 / 0.28 |
| First peak schedule | 2026-08-16 16:00 – 2026-09-10 04:00 | peak 0.014 / 0.44 / 1.32, off-peak half |
| V4.1 Flash repricing | from 2026-09-10 04:00 | peak 0.006 / 0.3 / 1.2, off-peak half |
dsh-tidewatch README · Three price eras：Cost = input-miss × cacheMiss + output × output + (cache read + cache write) × cacheHit; output already includes reasoning tokens. The ledger is kept in USD.

dsh-tidewatch README · Three price eras：CNY figures are taken verbatim from the official **Chinese** pricing page rather than converted: the two models' implied exchange rates differ (flash ≈ 6.67, pro ≈ 6.82), so a single rate would put pro's yuan figure about 2% below the official one. **Session totals use each model's own official rate** — converted per model when the per-model ledger is available, and falling back to the single rate otherwise — so a session that mixes flash and pro is not skewed either.

dsh-tidewatch README · Weekends and public holidays：- **Saturday and Sunday** are billed off-peak all day (official announcement: weekends no longer split into peak/off-peak and are charged at the low tier)
- **Chinese public holidays** are off-peak all day with no peak window and no effective date (official pricing footnote: peak hours are Beijing Monday–Friday excluding Chinese public holidays; weekends and holidays are off-peak all day)
- **Make-up working weekends** are likewise off-peak all day (official note)
- The next switch point is the next working day's first entry into peak

dsh-tidewatch README · Weekends and public holidays：The holiday table follows the State Council's 2026 arrangement (33 days): New Year 1/1–1/3, Spring Festival 2/15–2/23, Qingming 4/4–4/6, Labour Day 5/1–5/5, Dragon Boat 6/19–6/21, Mid-Autumn 9/25–9/27, National Day 10/1–10/7.

dsh-tidewatch README · Known limitations：- **Price table is built in**; after an official price change, update both `lib/pricing.js` (billing) and `DISPLAY_PRICES` in `lib/client.js` (display), and add a historical era for the old prices
- **Holiday table covers 2026 only**; the 2027 arrangement needs to be added to `CN_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` (both files) once published. Past that point weekdays are billed as workdays, so the panel warns that the table has expired

- **Failed or retried calls are not billed**, matching the official token-meter definition; that is the ceiling of the definition, not an omission
- **Two pricing paths on the account provider**: on this machine the provider (`deepseek-account`) does report usage, so calls are priced from tokens.
